## coal-deposits__README.md
# Utah Coal Deposit Areas (1988)

Statewide coal deposit-area polygons for Utah, from the Utah SGID **Coal Deposit Areas 1988**
layer (Utah Geological Survey / Utah Geospatial Resource Center). **94 polygons** across 12
named/unnamed coal deposit areas covering the state's principal coal fields — including the
**Kaiparowits Plateau** field on Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument, one of the largest
coal deposits in the United States.

This is the coal **resource-footprint** layer (what the resource is), the counterpart to
interest/activity layers such as leases, mining claims and permits, and to the UGS mineral- and
energy-occurrence points.

- **Extent:** Utah (statewide)
- **Native H3 resolution:** 8 (parent: `h0`) — coal deposit areas are large-area footprints; `h8`
  is the catalog's universal join key
- **Attributes:** coal deposit-area name (`KMDA_NAME`), deposit-area number (`KMDA_NUMBE`),
  favorability class (`FAV_CODE`), acreage (`ACREAGE`). Coal-bearing formation, rank, bed thickness
  and resource/reserve estimates are **not** carried by this SGID display layer.
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0 — **attribution: Utah Geological Survey / Utah Geospatial Resource Center (SGID)**

## Assets

| Asset | URL |
|---|---|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/coal-deposits.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/coal-deposits.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/coal-deposits/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

## MapLibre GL JS

The PMTiles **`source-layer` is `coal-deposits`** (not the source layer name):

```js
map.addSource('coal-deposits', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/coal-deposits.pmtiles'
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'coal-deposits-fill',
  type: 'fill',
  source: 'coal-deposits',
  'source-layer': 'coal-deposits',        // = last segment of the dataset name
  paint: {
    'fill-color': '#5b3a29',
    'fill-opacity': 0.5,
    'fill-outline-color': '#2b1a12'
  }
});
```

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;

-- All coal deposit areas
SELECT KMDA_NAME, ACREAGE
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/coal-deposits.parquet');

-- Total acreage per coal field (each field can be several polygons — SUM over DISTINCT features)
SELECT KMDA_NAME, SUM(ACREAGE) AS acres, COUNT(*) AS polygons
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/coal-deposits.parquet')
GROUP BY KMDA_NAME ORDER BY acres DESC;
```

### Querying the H3 hex

One hex row = one `(feature, h8)` pair. `ACREAGE` / `Shape__Area` / `Shape__Length` are
**per-feature totals repeated on every hex row** the polygon covers — **dedup by `_cng_fid`
before any SUM**:

```sql
-- Correct field-level acreage from the hex asset
SELECT KMDA_NAME, SUM(ACREAGE) AS acres FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT _cng_fid, KMDA_NAME, ACREAGE
  FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/coal-deposits/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
) GROUP BY KMDA_NAME;
```

For deposit-area extent, derive area from the H3 footprint (see the catalog h3-guide) rather than
summing an attribute.

## Source

Utah SGID `CoalDepositAreas1988` FeatureServer
(`https://services1.arcgis.com/99lidPhWCzftIe9K/ArcGIS/rest/services/CoalDepositAreas1988/FeatureServer/0`),
product page <https://gis.utah.gov/products/sgid/energy/coal/>. Native NAD83 UTM 12N, re-projected
to EPSG:4326.


## ugs-mineral-occurrences__README.md
# Utah Geological Survey — Mineral Occurrences (UMOS)

State-authoritative mineral & energy occurrence data for **Utah** from the Utah
Geological Survey (UGS) **Utah Mineral Occurrence System (UMOS)**: 7,388 point
features covering mineral occurrences, prospects, mines, and selected energy
resources, with commodity, resource type, deposit type/model, development status,
host-rock, and land-status attributes. More detailed and Utah-specific than the
national USGS MRDS / BLM mining-claim layers. **Scoped to Utah only.**

- **Source layer:** UGS UMOS ArcGIS MapServer layer 0 "Mineral Occurrences" —
  `https://webmaps.geology.utah.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Energy_Mineral/UMOS/MapServer/0`
  (native EPSG:26912 / UTM 12N, re-projected to EPSG:4326).
- **Distribution / license:** Utah SGID (UGRC). Licensed **CC-BY-4.0** —
  attribution to the **Utah Geological Survey (UGS) / Utah Geospatial Resource
  Center (UGRC)**. See <https://gis.utah.gov/documentation/policy/license/>.
- **Geometry:** point. Each occurrence was mapped to exactly one **H3 resolution-10**
  cell (native), with parent resolutions 9, 8, 0. No reducer, no dedup; points in
  the same cell are not merged.
- **Dating:** the dataset is effectively **undated** — there is no uniform
  occurrence-date field. `DISCOVERED` is a *sparse* discovery year (~12% of records),
  `DATE_` is a database record date, and `AGE_MA` is a geologic mineralization age in
  millions of years. No `year` column was derived.

## Assets

| Asset | File | Use |
|---|---|---|
| GeoParquet | `ugs-mineral-occurrences.parquet` | DuckDB / SQL queries |
| PMTiles | `ugs-mineral-occurrences.pmtiles` | Web map (point / `circle` layer) |
| H3 hex | `ugs-mineral-occurrences/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` | Spatial joins / aggregation |

## MapLibre GL JS

The PMTiles **`source-layer` is `ugs-mineral-occurrences`**. This is point data — use a
`circle` layer.

```js
import * as pmtiles from "pmtiles";
const protocol = new pmtiles.Protocol();
maplibregl.addProtocol("pmtiles", protocol.tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({
  container: "map",
  style: "https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json",
  center: [-111.5, 39.5],
  zoom: 6,
});

map.on("load", () => {
  map.addSource("umos", {
    type: "vector",
    url: "pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-mineral-occurrences.pmtiles",
  });
  map.addLayer({
    id: "mineral-occurrences",
    type: "circle",
    source: "umos",
    "source-layer": "ugs-mineral-occurrences",
    paint: {
      "circle-radius": 4,
      "circle-color": [
        "match", ["get", "TYPE_"],
        "Metal", "#e6550d",
        "Ind. Min.", "#3182bd",
        "Energy", "#756bb1",
        "Metal - Energy", "#c94a4a",
        "#999999"
      ],
      "circle-stroke-width": 0.5,
      "circle-stroke-color": "#333",
    },
  });
});
```

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;

-- Occurrences by commodity type and development status
SELECT TYPE_, STATUS, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-mineral-occurrences.parquet')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY n DESC;

-- Uranium occurrences in San Juan County
SELECT SITE_NAME, COMMODITY, STATUS, DISTRICT, ST_AsText(geom) AS location
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-mineral-occurrences.parquet')
WHERE COUNTY = 'San Juan' AND COMMODITY LIKE '%U%';
```

### H3 hex

One hex row = one (occurrence, cell) pair. Count occurrences with
`COUNT(DISTINCT _cng_fid)`; when rolling finer cells up to `h8`/`h0`, use `COUNT`
(never `SUM`) — several points can share a coarse cell.

```sql
-- Occurrence density per resolution-8 cell
SELECT h8, COUNT(DISTINCT _cng_fid) AS n_occurrences
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-mineral-occurrences/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
GROUP BY h8
ORDER BY n_occurrences DESC;
```

## Attribution

Data © Utah Geological Survey (UGS), distributed via the Utah Geospatial Resource
Center (UGRC) State Geographic Information Database (SGID) under CC BY 4.0. Processed
into cloud-native formats (GeoParquet, PMTiles, H3) by the Boettiger Lab
`cng-datasets` pipeline.


## ugs-uranium__README.md
# Utah Geological Survey — Uranium Districts, Areas, Past Producers, Permitted Mines & Mills

Utah's uranium geology and mining history from the Utah Geological Survey (UGS) and the Utah
Division of Oil, Gas and Mining (UDOGM), distributed through the Utah Geospatial Resource
Center (UGRC/SGID). Utah statewide.

| layer | features | geometry | what it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `districts` | 58 | polygon | Uranium districts with the survey's uranium potential class |
| `area-boundaries` | 15 | polygon | Broad Colorado Plateau uranium areas (UGS Map 215) |
| `past-producers` | 748 | point | Past uranium producers, full USGS CRIB record |
| `permitted-mines` | 25 | point | Permitted uranium / uranium-vanadium mines |
| `mills` | 2 | point | Utah's two uranium processing mills |

Each layer is published as GeoParquet, PMTiles and an H3 hex parquet at native resolution 8
(parent `h0`).

STAC: <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-uranium/stac-collection.json>

## Read it with DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
INSTALL httpfs;  LOAD httpfs;

-- Uranium potential by district
SELECT POTENTIAL, COUNT(*) AS districts
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-uranium/districts.parquet')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY districts DESC;

-- Past producers by county (722 of the 748 carry attributes)
SELECT COUNTY, COUNT(*) AS sites
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-uranium/past-producers.parquet')
WHERE COUNTY IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sites DESC;

-- The two mills
SELECT NAME, OPERATOR, COUNTY
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-uranium/mills.parquet');
```

The hex assets are hive-partitioned on `h0`:

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT _cng_fid) AS districts, COUNT(DISTINCT h8) AS cells
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-uranium/districts/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet');
```

## Show it on a map

Each layer is its own PMTiles archive. The MapLibre `source-layer` is the layer name:
`districts`, `area-boundaries`, `past-producers`, `permitted-mines`, `mills`.

```js
import maplibregl from 'maplibre-gl';
import * as pmtiles from 'pmtiles';

maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new pmtiles.Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({
  container: 'map',
  style: 'https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/positron-gl-style/style.json',
  center: [-109.9, 38.3],
  zoom: 6,
});

map.on('load', () => {
  map.addSource('uranium-districts', {
    type: 'vector',
    url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-uranium/districts.pmtiles',
  });

  map.addLayer({
    id: 'districts-fill',
    type: 'fill',
    source: 'uranium-districts',
    'source-layer': 'districts',          // = the layer name
    paint: {
      'fill-color': [
        'match', ['get', 'POTENTIAL'],
        'High', '#b2182b',
        'Moderate', '#ef8a62',
        'Low', '#fddbc7',
        'None', '#f7f7f7',
        '#cccccc',                         // unclassified (NULL)
      ],
      'fill-opacity': 0.7,
    },
  });

  map.addSource('uranium-past-producers', {
    type: 'vector',
    url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-utah/ugs-uranium/past-producers.pmtiles',
  });

  map.addLayer({
    id: 'past-producers-pts',
    type: 'circle',
    source: 'uranium-past-producers',
    'source-layer': 'past-producers',
    paint: { 'circle-radius': 3, 'circle-color': '#2166ac' },
  });
});
```

## Things to know before you use it

**The two polygon layers are not a hierarchy.** Districts and areas share no key and no
name. 47 of the 58 districts sit entirely inside a single area and 4 more sit 93–98% inside
one, but 7 districts (Spor Mountain, Honeycomb Hills, East Erickson, Blawn Mountain, Silver
Reef, Marysvale, Newton) lie outside every area, because the areas cover the Colorado
Plateau and those districts are in western Utah. Rolling districts up to areas drops those
seven. Relate them spatially:

```sql
SELECT d.NAME AS district, a.NAME AS area
FROM read_parquet('.../districts.parquet') d
LEFT JOIN read_parquet('.../area-boundaries.parquet') a
  ON ST_Intersects(d.geom, a.geom);
```

**Do not add counts across layers.** The layers overlap each other, and overlap the sibling
`ugs-mineral-occurrences` and `usgs-mrds` collections, with no shared identifier. One mine
can appear as a past producer, a permitted mine and a mineral occurrence. Count within a
single layer with `COUNT(DISTINCT _cng_fid)`.

**Production and reserve figures need parsing.** On `past-producers` the `*_AMT`, `*_U`,
`*_ITEM`, `*_ACC`, `*_YEAR` and `*_GRADE` columns follow the USGS CRIB record format:

- Each holds several entries packed into one string, separated by `ý` (U+00FD).
- Each amount is in **thousands** of the unit named in the parallel `*_U` entry.
- Units vary between entries of one record, and spellings vary between records
  (`LB`, `LBS`, `ST`, `TONS`).
- Entries cover different commodities (`U`, `V`, `ORE U`, `CON U`).
- Entry counts disagree between the amount, unit and item fields in 30 records.

Reserves are also reported in three overlapping tables: `RPR_*` is the total, `R_*` its
reserves part and `PR_*` its potential-resources part, so adding all three counts the same
material twice. These columns are published as text exactly as received; parse before any
arithmetic.

**Point layers collapse onto shared hex cells.** At resolution 8 (~0.74 km² per cell) the
748 past producers fall on 551 distinct cells and the 25 permitted mines on 22. Points
sharing a cell are not deduplicated.

**Uranium potential classes are the survey's judgement.** `None` means no potential was
assigned, and is not a missing value; three districts are genuinely unclassified and are
`NULL`. The criteria behind High / Moderate / Low / None are not published by the publisher:
they are absent from the ArcGIS Online item metadata, the FGDC record, the UGRC product page
and UGS Map 215 itself.

**26 past producers have no attributes.** They carry valid coordinates but every descriptive
field is empty, so the count of described past producers is 722, not 748.

## Provenance

Retrieved 2026-09-22 from five ArcGIS Online feature services published by UGRC under the
SGID Energy theme (<https://gis.utah.gov/products/sgid/energy/>). The services are live and
unversioned: the publisher states no edition or release, so the access date is the only
edition marker and a later retrieval may differ.

The retrieved snapshot is staged at `s3://public-utah/raw/`:

| file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---|
| `ugs-uranium-districts.geojson` | 451,808 | `d236c2f9919757aed2e67311dd5799af9b3077c931f25b2b1b071dcd87d4bc7b` |
| `ugs-uranium-area-boundaries.geojson` | 358,579 | `bcd6cab751f6d8d401a0defde91061b0aab3ae1e846926b9cc35364f9060fca1` |
| `ugs-uranium-past-producers.geojson` | 2,637,065 | `a9f397422f1f1124b547a4390ebd441572bf30970002f3f05212a93b80e32e45` |
| `ugs-uranium-permitted-mines.geojson` | 13,723 | `4ed55d3585c27f13190134a0669988753d267d73f029b4cfd80d9f2674229394` |
| `ugs-uranium-mills.geojson` | 773 | `d38f3507945c4d213283274f6ee4f5516558a711db02a67d15dd2c2a395b62c5` |

Underlying compilation: Utah Geological Survey Map 215, *Uranium and Vanadium Map of Utah*
(Gloyn, R.W., Bon, R.L., Wakefield, S., and Krahulec, K., 2005). Past-producer attributes
follow the USGS Computerized Resources Information Bank (CRIB) record format described in
Keefer, E.K., and Calkins, J.A., 1978, *Description of individual data items and codes in
CRIB*: U.S. Geological Survey Circular 755-B, <https://doi.org/10.3133/cir755B>.

Only two changes were made to the source attributes: strings were trimmed of the fixed-width
space padding the SGID extract applies, and values that were empty after trimming were
stored as `NULL`.
